title: A measure reference in a row context performs the context transition implicitly

source.quote: when you invoke a measure from a DAX expression, this is automatically surrounded by CALCULATE
source.supports: a measure reference is wrapped in an implicit CALCULATE, which performs the context transition

source.quote: When you use a model measure in row context, context transition is automatic.
source.supports: a model measure used in row context transitions automatically

derivation: US customers are Ann (1) and Bob (2): Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 4, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 + 100 = 310. JP is Cho (3): rows 5, 6 = 200 + 30 = 230. FR is Dee (4): no sales, BLANK.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
